rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unusable or an action that is pointless or unhelpful.

example.english: This knife is useless; it can't cut anything.
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 dou1 mou5 jung6 cit3 m4 dou2 je5

rows.note: Use this colloquial adjective for a person who is good-for-nothing or bad at a particular activity.

example.english: You can't even do such a simple maths problem; you're really useless.
example.traditional: 你連咁簡單嘅數學題都唔識做，真係廢。
example.jyutping: nei5 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 sou3 hok6 tai4 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6 zan1 hai6 fai3

rows.note: Use this emphatic colloquial phrase when saying that someone is utterly useless at a task.

example.english: Even asking you to help move a table is too much; you're utterly useless.
example.traditional: 叫你幫手搬張枱都唔得，你真係冇鬼用。
example.jyutping: giu3 nei5 bong1 sau2 bun1 zoeng1 toi2 dou1 m4 dak1 nei5 zan1 hai6 mou5 gwai2 jung6
